content.short: R-Planet is a full-fledged Play-and-Earn strategy game developed by Wecan Dev.
content.description: R-Planet is a play-and-earn strategy game developed by Wecan Dev, delivered as a user-friendly mobile app. It features NFT-enabled strategy gameplay, enabling players to engage with the game on the go. With access anytime and anywhere, the app lets you enjoy its features and benefits wherever you are, using an intuitive interface and smooth controls to participate in the evolving world of R-Planet. This mobile experience keeps core gameplay accessible wherever you are, making it easy to jump into the action.
